**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation in either direction. Targeted searches ("most favored", "no less favorable", "favourable", "best rates", "favor", "pricing") returned no hits, and a complete read of the document confirms:

- **§5 Fees and Payment (p0023)** is a straightforward revenue-share plus sequential-liability payment mechanic, with no benchmarking of AP's terms against those given to any third party and no obligation to match third-party offers.
- **§1 (p0001)** cuts the other way in our favour, expressly confirming the arrangement is non-exclusive and that AP remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties.

This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no MFN burdening the Customer). The absence of a Vendor-granted MFN running to AP is not a deviation under this directional rule — it would be welcome but is not required — so it is noted here rather than flagged, and could be raised as a commercial ask if pricing terms are reopened.
